zh: 别指望周末天气会好。
en: Don't {count on|rely on|bank on} the weather being good this weekend.

zh: 我们在树下铺开了野餐垫。
en: We {spread out|laid out|put down} the picnic blanket under a tree.

zh: 下午雨应该会小一点。
en: The rain should {ease off|let up|die down|ease} by the afternoon.

zh: 雾越来越浓，所以我们就往回走了。
en: The fog was {closing in|coming in|rolling in}, so we turned back.

zh: 天气预报说下午会放晴。
en: The forecast says it should {brighten up|clear up|clear|improve} this afternoon.

zh: 今天下午应该会暖和起来。
en: It should {warm up} this afternoon.

zh: 尽管下雨，音乐会还是会照常举行。
en: The concert will {go ahead} despite the rain.

zh: 我们去游个泳凉快一下吧。
en: Let's go for a swim to {cool off|cool down}.

zh: 暴风雨中一根大树枝断掉了。
en: A big branch {broke off|snapped off|came off|fell off} in the storm.

zh: 外面冷得要命，穿暖和点。
en: It's freezing outside, so {wrap up|rug up|bundle up} warm.

zh: 穿暖和点，外面冷死了。
en: {Bundle up|Wrap up|Rug up}, it's freezing out there.

zh: 进屋之前先用毛巾把身子擦干。
en: Use the towel to {dry off|dry yourself|dry yourself off} before you come inside.

zh: 爬到半山腰，我的膝盖撑不住了。
en: My knee {gave out|gave way} halfway up the hill.

zh: 今天早上我们一醒来就看到外面下雪了。
en: We {woke up to} snow this morning.

zh: 我们的水撑不了多久了。
en: Our water won't {hold out|last} much longer.

zh: 昨晚风太大，我们的帐篷差点被吹走了。
en: Our tent nearly {blew away} in the wind last night.

zh: 中午太阳大的时候一定要把皮肤遮好。
en: Make sure you {cover up} in the midday sun.

zh: 下午太阳出来了。
en: The sun {came out} in the afternoon.

zh: 我们蹚过河才到了小屋。
en: We {waded through|waded across|crossed} the river to get to the hut.

zh: 一下雨，大家都往咖啡馆跑。
en: Everyone {made for|headed for|headed to|ran for} the café when it started raining.

zh: 放假的时候，我只想整天躺在海滩上什么都不干。
en: On holiday I just want to {lie around|laze around|lie about|laze about} on the beach all day.

zh: 暴风雨期间我们一直窝在家里。
en: We {hunkered down|holed up} at home during the storm.

zh: 昨晚的暴风雨让半个城市都停了电。
en: Last night's storm {knocked out|cut} power to half the city.

zh: 两条步道在小屋那里汇合。
en: The two tracks {meet up|join up|link up|meet|join} at the hut.

zh: 别在营地留下任何垃圾。
en: Don't {leave behind|leave} any rubbish at the campsite.

zh: 我们等风小一点再出发。
en: We waited for the wind to {die down|drop|ease|ease off|settle} before we set off.

zh: 开始下雨了，但我们还是继续往山顶走。
en: It started raining, but we {pushed on|pressed on|kept going|carried on|continued} to the summit.

zh: 我们在步道上被雨淋了个措手不及。
en: We got {caught out|caught} by the rain on the track.

zh: 我们应该在天黑之前往回走。
en: We should {head back|go back|turn back|get back} before it gets dark.

zh: 飓风来之前，大家都在囤水和食物。
en: Everyone is {stocking up on|loading up on|buying} water and food before the cyclone.

zh: 救生员在海滩上看护游泳的人。
en: Lifeguards {watch over|keep an eye on|look after|keep watch over} swimmers at the beach.

zh: 这里一到下午就热起来了。
en: It really {heats up|warms up} here in the afternoon.

zh: 暴风雨过后，我们停电了两天。
en: After the storm we had to {go without|do without} power for two days.

zh: 天一热我们就直奔海滩。
en: As soon as it got hot, we {headed for|headed to|made for|went to} the beach.

zh: 走得慢的人渐渐落在了后面。
en: The slower walkers {fell behind|dropped back|lagged behind}.

zh: 其他人往前走的时候，他留在了后面。
en: He {hung back|stayed back} while the others went ahead.

zh: 我们刚到海滩，天就阴下来了。
en: It {clouded over|clouded up|got cloudy} just as we got to the beach.

zh: 我们的独木舟在河中间翻了。
en: Our canoe {tipped over|capsized|flipped over|turned over|flipped} in the middle of the river.

zh: 外面下着倾盆大雨。
en: It's {pouring down|bucketing down|pouring|chucking it down} outside.

zh: 搬到惠灵顿后我迷上了徒步。
en: I {got into|got interested in|took up|started} tramping after I moved to Wellington.

zh: 把防晒霜抹匀，不然会晒伤。
en: {Rub in} the sunscreen properly or you'll get burnt.

zh: 带把伞吧，外面下着倾盆大雨。
en: Take an umbrella. It's {bucketing down|pouring|pouring down|pelting down|bucketing|teeming down} outside.

zh: 暴风雨应该今晚就会过去。
en: The storm should {blow over|pass|die down|clear} by tonight.

zh: 在米尔福德峡湾要当心沙蝇。
en: {Watch out for|Look out for|Beware of} sandflies at Milford Sound.

zh: 天气变差了，所以我们在登顶前折返了。
en: The weather got worse, so we {turned back|went back|headed back} before the summit.

zh: 涨潮了，我们把毛巾挪一下吧。
en: The tide's {coming in}, so let's move our towels.
